history.summary: A 99LH 1BR (Le Quest, D23 Bukit Batik mixed-use) at $805k / $1,626 psf — slightly below the $1,664 URA median, with reliable data (118 txns) but a weak 1.55% CAGR and a losing arena record (117-183). An integrated-development shoebox with steady fundamentals but anaemic appreciation.
history.rating_rationale: Le Quest is an integrated mixed-use development (mall + residences) which aids liquidity and rental, and the data is robust (118 txns), with the $1,626 psf ~2% below the $1,664 median — a small cushion at a low $805k quantum. But the 1.55% CAGR is genuinely weak (D23 OCR with no standout catalyst yet — JRL Tengah Park is 1.08km), and the poor arena record (Elo 1,029, 117-183) and off-frontier status flag soft demand. Reliable but low-growth; a yield/own-stay-leaning Neutral, not a growth buy.
red_flags: Weak 1.55% CAGR despite reliable 118-txn data — low growth
Losing arena record (117-183, Elo 1,029) — soft relative demand
1.08km to Tengah Park JRL station (not yet operational)
catalysts: Integrated mixed-use (mall + residences) — convenience aids rental/resale
Slightly below URA median at a low $805k quantum
Tengah/Jurong precinct growth over the long run
